auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%m', t.XCL_011) AS month
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
WHERE 
    c.XCL_003 IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
    AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
    AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013'
GROUP BY 
    strftime('%m', t.XCL_011)
ORDER BY 
    SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
LIMIT 1
